entities.summary: Andrei Aleksandrovich Bashko is a Belarusian former professional ice hockey defenceman. Bashko began playing professionally in 1998 in the Eastern European Hockey League with Yunost Minsk. He also later played for Keramin Minsk. He had previously played for Metallurg Novokuznetsk and Amur Khabarovsk in the Kontinental Hockey League. At an international level, Bashko played for the Belarusian national team at three World Championships.
